info.title: Billivo API
info.description: Billivo public API. Create, query and update invoices, manage the invoice number series, and read the expenses of Billivo Gastos (Billivo Expenses) for an ERP integration.

post.description: Returns the access token for all other calls. The response includes a refresh token, but the API has no endpoint to exchange it. To renew the access token, call `POST /token` again.

400.description: The request is not valid, or the user must complete a challenge.

403.description: The user must reset the password.

post.description:
Creates an invoice (ordinary or rectificative), registers it in Veri*Factu and returns the PDF.

- NON_ERP company: do not send `invoiceNumber`. Billivo numbers the invoice from the series in `header.formatId`, or from the default series of the type (see `GET /invoice/series`).
- ERP company: send `invoiceNumber`. A number that is already on a registered invoice of the company is rejected.

400.description: A field is missing or not valid, or `dueDate` is before today. The `error` field is one string with all the problems. The messages are in Spanish.

401.description: Unauthorized. When the token is missing or not valid, the API gateway rejects the request. In that case the body is `{ "message": "Unauthorized" }`, not `ErrorResponse`.

500.description: Internal server error. Also returned when the invoice cannot be registered, for example: the ERP invoiceNumber is already registered, the formatId series does not exist or does not number this invoice type, or the company has no default series. The `error` field has the reason.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: If `true`, Billivo sends the PDF to `customer.mailAddress`. Billivo does not send it for F2 and R5 invoices, or when the customer has no email. A failed email does not fail the request: see `emailSent` in the response.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language of the PDF. Without it, the PDF uses the language of the company. A customer outside Spain always gets the PDF in English.

get.summary: Get all invoices or specific invoice
get.description: Retrieves invoices for a specific user. Can retrieve all invoices or a specific invoice by number.

parameters.name: userEmail
parameters.description: Email of the user whose invoices to retrieve

parameters.name: invoiceNumber
parameters.description: Specific invoice number to retrieve. If not provided, returns all invoices for the user.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by invoice status. An unknown value returns 400. `overdue` is computed from the due date: it returns unpaid invoices whose `dueDate` has passed, and their `status` field can still be `sent`.

parameters.name: pdf
parameters.description: If `true`, each invoice includes its stored PDF in `base64pdf`. Without it, `base64pdf` is null.

401.description: Unauthorized. When the token is missing or not valid, the API gateway rejects the request. In that case the body is `{ "message": "Unauthorized" }`, not `ErrorResponse`.

404.description: The user of `userEmail` is not registered

patch.description: Marks an invoice as paid, or undoes the payment. It only applies to an invoice whose status is `sent` or `paid`.

parameters.name: userEmail
parameters.description: Email of the user who owns the invoice

409.description: The invoice status is not `sent` or `paid`. The `error` field shows the current status.

get.description: Returns the F and C series of the company of the token.

post.description: Creates a series for the company of the token. The first series of a type becomes the default series of that type.

400.description: Validation errors, one message per invalid field

409.description: Another series of the company already prints numbers with the same prefix, year and separators

get.summary: Export the expenses of a date range
get.description: Without `format`, returns a link to a ZIP file with an Excel of the expenses (and the receipts if `includeImages=true`). With `format=json`, returns one page of expenses.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `json` for a page of expenses. Without it, a ZIP file.

parameters.name: includeImages
parameters.description: ZIP only. If `true`, the ZIP includes the receipt files.

parameters.name: paid
parameters.description: `true` returns only paid expenses (with `paidAt`), `false` only unpaid ones. Without it, both. It works with the ZIP and with JSON.

200.description: ZIP link, or one page of expenses with format=json

url.description: Presigned link. It expires after 5 minutes.

400.description: from or to is missing or not a valid range

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

get.summary: Get the expenses to register in the ERP
get.description: Returns the confirmed expenses that no ERP registered yet, in order of expenseId. To get the next page, send `after` = the last expenseId of this page. An empty `expenses` array means there are no more.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The last expenseId of the previous page.

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

post.summary: Confirm the expenses registered in the ERP
post.description: Stores the ERP id of each expense. After this, the expense is not in `GET /expenses/erp` and users cannot edit or delete it in Billivo Gastos. You can send the same erpId again, so a retry is safe.

rejected.description: Expenses that do not exist, are not confirmed, are deleted, or already have a different erpId.

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

patch.summary: Change the status of an expense
patch.description:
Marks an expense as paid or unpaid, or reviews a pending expense (confirms or rejects it). Send either `paid` or `reviewStatus`, not both.

- `paid`: allowed in any state of the expense, also when it is in the ERP or in a closed period.
- `reviewStatus`: only for a pending expense that is not in the ERP or in a closed period. A review is final. Only confirmed expenses are in `GET /expenses/erp` and `GET /expenses/export`. To reject, `rejectionReason` is required, and only expenses uploaded by an employee can be rejected.

paid.description: true marks the expense as paid. false removes the payment.

schema.description: The updated expense, with every column of the expense. Only the status fields are listed here. It is not the `Expense` schema: amounts are strings (for example `"121.00"`), the dates of the `Expense` schema are date-times (for example `"2026-03-12T00:00:00.000Z"`), and it does not have `categoryName`, `paymentMethodName`, `documentTypeName`, `vatLines` or `receipt`.

paidAt.description: Date and time when the expense was marked as paid: in the web, through `PATCH /expenses/status`, or when it got a payment method with `markAsPaid`. It is not the bank payment date. Marking a paid expense again keeps the first date. null when the expense is not paid.

paidSource.description: How the expense was marked as paid: `web` (the Billivo Expenses app, web or mobile), `api` (`PATCH /expenses/status`) or `payment_method` (it got a payment method with `markAsPaid`). Marking a paid expense again keeps the first value. null when the expense is not paid, and for expenses marked as paid before version 1.5.0.

paidBy.description: Email of the user who marked the expense as paid. Through the API it is the Billivo Expenses account of the company. Marking a paid expense again keeps the first value. null when the expense is not paid, and for expenses marked as paid before version 1.5.0.

400.description: The body is not valid. Also REJECTION_REASON_REQUIRED and ONLY_EMPLOYEE_EXPENSES_CAN_BE_REJECTED.

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

409.description: EXPENSE_ALREADY_REVIEWED (the expense is not pending), EXPENSE_IN_ERP or EXPENSE_IN_CLOSED_PERIOD

get.description: Returns the expense categories of the company. A categoryId never changes, so the ERP can map each one to an account.

active.description: A category is deactivated, never deleted.

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

get.summary: List the payment methods of the expenses
get.description: Returns the payment methods of the company. A paymentMethodId never changes, so the ERP can map each one to its own payment type.

active.description: A payment method is deactivated, never deleted.

markAsPaid.description: If true, an expense that gets this payment method is marked as paid (it gets a paidAt).

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

get.summary: List the suppliers of the expenses
get.description: Returns the suppliers of the company, also the inactive ones. Billivo Gastos creates them from the invoices the company reviews. A supplier is identified by its tax id. To compare tax ids, the EU VAT prefix is ignored: `ES74894836M` and `74894836M` are the same supplier. An expense has no supplierId: its supplier is the one with the same tax id as its `merchantTaxId`.

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

patch.description: Changes the fields sent. A field that is not sent does not change. A field sent empty (`""` or `null`) is cleared, except `taxId` and `name`, which are required. Use it to save the ERP id of the supplier in `erpId`.

active.description: false deactivates the supplier. A supplier is never deleted.

400.description: Invalid body, supplierId missing or a field not valid

403.description: The company does not have Billivo Gastos access

409.description: SUPPLIER_TAX_ID_EXISTS: another supplier has this tax id, with or without the EU VAT prefix

BasicAuth.description: HTTP Basic Authentication for client credentials (usually client_id and client_secret).

taxId.description: Stored with letters and digits only, in upper case. It keeps the EU VAT prefix when the invoice shows it.

erpId.description: Id of the supplier in the ERP.

active.description: A supplier is deactivated, never deleted.

status.description: `paid` marks the invoice as paid. `sent` undoes the payment.
New status of the invoice. Same value as `body.status`.

mailAddress.description: Email of a Billivo user of the same company as the token. It identifies the company that issues the invoice. A user of another company gives a 401.

invoiceType.description: FX for Invoices, RX for Corrective (Rectificativas)

invoiceNumber.description: ERP only: required. A NON_ERP company cannot send it, Billivo generates it.

correctedInvoiceNumber.description: If you are correcting an invoice (invoiceType = R), use this field to reference the original invoice.

correctiveType.description: If you are correcting an invoice (invoiceType = R), use this field to select the corrective type, 'I' to correct by difference and 'S' to correct by substitution.

paymentTermDays.description: Required. The API does not return it.

paymentType.description: `Others` is a synonym of `Other`. Responses return `Other`.

paymentTypeDescription.description: Additional details about the payment method (IBAN for bank transfers)

bankName.description: Name of the bank. Required when `paymentType` is `Bank Transfer`.

SWIFT.description: SWIFT/BIC code of the bank (8 or 11 characters). Required for international transfers.

dueDate.description: The date cannot be before today (date in Spain). The date cannot be before `invoiceDate`.

discount.description: The API accepts this field, but does not store it and does not return it.

taxType.description: Tax: 01 IVA, 02 IPSI (Ceuta and Melilla), 03 IGIC (Canary Islands), 05 other.

regimeKey.description: Tax regime code. Default is '01' for general regime.

pos.description: The API accepts this field, but does not store it and does not return it.

currencyExchange.description: The API accepts this field, but does not store it and does not return it.

customFields.description: The API accepts this field, but does not store it and does not return it. The property `orderReference` is the exception: the API stores it and returns it. Key-value pairs for custom data.

formatId.description: NON_ERP only. The id of the series that numbers the invoice, from `GET /invoice/series`. The series must be of type F for an F invoice and of type C for an R invoice. Without it, Billivo uses the default series of the type. An ERP company cannot send this field.

itemId.description: Unique identifier for the item - Used to show the item in the invoice in order

customFields.description: The API accepts this field, but does not store it and does not return it. Key-value pairs for custom item data.

equivalenceSurcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge rate (recargo de equivalencia) in %. Send it together with `equivalenceSurchargeTax`, or send neither.

equivalenceSurchargeTax.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line. Send it together with `equivalenceSurcharge`.

calificacionOperacion.description: Veri*Factu operation type: S1 subject, S2 subject with reverse charge, N1 and N2 not subject.

operacionExenta.description: Veri*Factu exemption cause (for example E1). Send it for an exempt line.

InvoiceResponseHeader.description: Header of an invoice that the API returns. It does not include `invoiceDate`, `formatId`, `paymentTermDays`, `pos` and `currencyExchange`.

additionalNotes.description: The text `No additional notes` when the request had no notes.

InvoiceResponseItem.description: Line of an invoice that the API returns. It does not include `equivalenceSurcharge`, `equivalenceSurchargeTax` and `customFields`.

taxId.description: Identifier of the tax of the line in Billivo. It can be null.

POS.description: The API accepts this object, but does not store it and does not return it. Point of Sale (POS) information.

CurrencyExchange.description: The API accepts this object, but does not store it and does not return it. Currency conversion details.

exchangeRateDate.description: Date when the exchange rate was set

totalAmountInBaseCurrency.description: Total invoice amount in base currency

TokenResponse.description: The successful response payload for a token retrieval endpoint.

access_token.description: The **JWT access token** used for authenticating all subsequent resource API calls.

token_type.description: Indicates how the access token should be used. Should be **'Bearer'**.

expires_in.description: The lifetime in **seconds** of the access token.

id_token.description: An **OpenID Connect (OIDC) token** containing claims about the authenticated user.

refresh_token.description: The API returns a refresh token, but has no endpoint to exchange it. To renew the access token, call `POST /token` again.

TokenErrorResponse.description: The error response payload for token retrieval.

status.description: Current status of the invoice. `sent`: registered at the AEAT. `validated_with_errors`: accepted by the AEAT with errors. `error`: rejected by the AEAT. `cancelled`: annulled. `rectified`: corrected by a corrective invoice. An invoice created with `POST /invoice` is `sent` or `validated_with_errors`.

base64pdf.description: PDF of the invoice in base64 (without the data: prefix). Only in `GET /invoice?pdf=true`.

emailSent.description: True if Billivo sent the invoice to the customer (query parameter `email=true`).

type.description: F numbers invoices (F1, F2). C numbers rectificatives (R1, R5).

default.description: Billivo uses the default series of the type when the invoice has no formatId.

invoiceYear.description: Digits of the year in the number. 0 means no year.

firstSeparator.description: Between the prefix and the year.

secondSeparator.description: Between the year and the counter.

CreateInvoiceSeriesRequest.description: The series above prints numbers as WEB-2026/00001. A series with a year starts again from 1 in a new year.

type.description: F for invoices, C for rectificatives.

firstNumber.description: The number of the first invoice of the series. Use it to continue a numbering that started in another system.

example: 'invoiceDigits' debe ser un número entero entre 1 y 15.

Expense.description: A confirmed expense. Amounts are numbers, dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

documentId.description: Id of the scanned document of the expense.

companyId.description: Id of the company of the token.

createdBy.description: Email of the user who uploaded the expense: the company account or one of its employees.

expenseDate.description: null only in `GET /expenses/erp`, when the expense was confirmed without a date. `GET /expenses/export` filters by this date, so there it is never null.

closingDate.description: Date that places the expense in a closing period. By default it is `expenseDate`.

totalAmount.description: null when the expense was confirmed without an amount.

irpfPercent.description: IRPF withholding rate (%). 0 when the invoice has no withholding.

irpfAmount.description: IRPF withholding amount, computed on taxBase. totalAmount is taxBase + VAT, so the net to pay is totalAmount - irpfAmount.

categoryId.description: See `GET /expenses/categories`. null when the expense has no category.

categoryName.description: Name of the category. Empty string when the expense has no category.

paymentMethodName.description: Name of the payment method. Empty string when the expense has no payment method.

dueDate.description: Payment due date of the invoice.

iban.description: IBAN of the merchant, without spaces, to pay by transfer. null for any other payment method.

erpId.description: The id that the ERP sent in `POST /expenses/erp`.

reviewStatus.description: Review status. These endpoints only return confirmed expenses, so it is always `confirmed`.

reviewedAt.description: Date and time of the review. null for expenses confirmed before the review existed.

paidAt.description: Date and time when the expense was marked as paid: in the web, through `PATCH /expenses/status`, or when it got a payment method with `markAsPaid`. It is not the bank payment date. Marking a paid expense again keeps the first date. null when the expense is not paid.

paidSource.description: How the expense was marked as paid: `web` (the Billivo Expenses app, web or mobile), `api` (`PATCH /expenses/status`) or `payment_method` (it got a payment method with `markAsPaid`). Marking a paid expense again keeps the first value. null when the expense is not paid, and for expenses marked as paid before version 1.5.0.

paidBy.description: Email of the user who marked the expense as paid. Through the API it is the Billivo Expenses account of the company. Marking a paid expense again keeps the first value. null when the expense is not paid, and for expenses marked as paid before version 1.5.0.

reviewedBy.description: Email of the user who reviewed the expense. null for expenses confirmed before the review existed.

rejectionReason.description: Reason of a rejection. These endpoints only return confirmed expenses, so it is always null.

ocrStatus.description: Status of the automatic reading of the document.

ocrConfidence.description: How sure the automatic reading is that every field is right, from 0 to 100. null if it did not give a value.

ocrConfirmedAt.description: Date and time when the user confirmed the data of the automatic reading.

recordHash.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the fiscal fields of the expense and the hash of its document. It detects a change of the data or of the document.

closingPeriodId.description: Id of the closing period that contains the expense. null while the period is open.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the expense was created.

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the last change of the expense.

vatLines.description: VAT breakdown, one line per VAT rate.

url.description: Presigned link to the receipt file. It expires after 5 minutes.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Get the OAuth2 token for all other calls.

tags.name: Invoice series
tags.description: Number series of the company. Only NON_ERP companies use them: an ERP sends its own invoiceNumber.

tags.name: Expenses
tags.description: Expenses of Billivo Gastos. The company of the token must have Billivo Gastos access, else the API returns 403. The API only returns confirmed expenses that are not deleted.
